➡️About this Game 

Tee off like a PGA TOUR Pro on iconic championship golf courses, and leave your mark on the leaderboard.


Take your best shot on the world’s most iconic golf courses with PGA TOUR Pro Golf, an Apple Arcade exclusive that brings the thrill of professional golf to your fingertips. Compete, upgrade, and rise to the top in this immersive golf experience.


Play Real-World Courses

Test your skills on breathtaking recreations of legendary courses, including:


- Pebble Beach Golf Links

- The Links at Spanish Bay

- Spyglass Hill Golf Course

- Firestone Country Club

- Bay Hill Club & Lodge

- Harbour Town Golf Links

- Latrobe Country Club

…and more on the way!


Simultaneous Head-To-Head Mode

Forget waiting for turns—compete in real-time against fellow golfers as everyone plays simultaneously. Fast-paced and thrilling, it’s golf like you’ve never played before.


Daily and Multi-Day Tournaments

Challenge yourself with multi-round tournaments held daily or across multiple days. Prove your skills and climb the leaderboards to earn exclusive rewards.


Gear Up and Earn Big

Customize your game by upgrading clubs and equipment. Earn coins and cash across all modes to unlock the best gear to improve your performance.


Download PGA TOUR Pro Golf now on Apple Arcade and bring your A-game to the most celebrated golf courses. Are you ready to tee off and take the crown?


Features at a Glance:


- Stunning real-world courses, faithfully recreated

- Real-time, simultaneous head-to-head mode

- Competitive daily and multi-day tournaments

- Gear upgrades and rewards to enhance your play

- Tee up on the world’s greatest golf courses.


Download now and start your journey!


Genres: Sports 
Platform: iOS 
Size: 2.85 GB
Publisher: HypGames, Inc. 
Release Date: Feb 06, 2025
